draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.20, the 89th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 8th of 30 at LB. He went 85th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2022) ranked 3rd in tackles among the 30 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Los Angeles Chargers. 48 career games and 33 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 8 AV in 2025 against a career-best 9 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: sacks 3.5 (94th percentile), approximate value 8 (87th percentile), passes defended 5 (85th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 off-ball linebacker who played: 103 combined tackles against a median of 40, above the norm.
